title: LolCraft
description: Small april fools mod by DAV222
body:
# About
This mod made by youtuber DAV222 and uploaded by Wertyfire. It adds some funny (and useless) content for april fools day.

# Features
## New blocks:
Potato Block - made from poisonous potatoes

Lol Block - made from glowstone, gold blocks and poisonous potatoes

## New items:
Potato Apple, Potato Cake and

Potato Sword - deals 100 damage and made from stick and poisonous potatoes

## New mobs:
Lol Creeper - dangerous guy, can be found in the night. Its better to use Potato Sword against him

Lol Pig - like usual pig but with less hp

Corresponding eggs may be crafted.

## New dimension
Lol Aether - new dimension, consists of diamond islands.
You should manually create portal by using command "/setblock <coordinates> lolrofl:lol_aether_portal"

## Other
Also mod has 7 achievements

Recommended to use any recipe viewer mod
